name: HYDRA-UMC-NODE-HEALING
notes: Established v0: real gRPC-based health watchdog with real failover wired in - OrchestratorReactor (watchdog.Reactor's real implementation) calls HYDRA-UMC-ORCHESTRATOR's own POST /nodes/:node/recover on every unhealthy transition. checkNode retries a transport-level failure (dial/RPC error) via a bounded, deterministic RetryPolicy (default 3 attempts, exponential backoff 250ms->2s cap) before classifying a node UNREACHABLE, masking transient network blips without an open-ended retry loop. A node that answers but misreports its own identity (missing or mismatched NodeIdentity.Name) is classified StatusInvalid and never trusted or retried - retrying cannot fix a node lying about its own name. A registry entry with a healthUrl is probed with one HTTP GET (2xx healthy, 5xx unhealthy, no answer unreachable and retried, redirect or 4xx invalid and never retried) because no service of the ecosystem implements the gRPC HealthService; the recovery request carries a bearer token when -orchestrator-token or ORCHESTRATOR_TOKEN is set. 48 tests.
